pattern: permanent registration of an evaluation workspace
experience: Throwaway evaluation folders showed up as ordinary sidebar projects.
rule: Register a throwaway workspace with temporary:true.
prompt: Register the existing folder /home/user/eval-run as a T3 Code project named Eval run. It is throwaway workspace only for this evaluation run and will be removed at wrap-up.

pattern: temporary registration of a permanent project
experience: A user-requested permanent project belongs in the normal project lists.
prompt: Register the existing folder /home/user/app as my new long-term T3 Code project named App.
